main_text.l: xitu everterentur, cum ecclesia remp. in
max. nimium quantum deprefsere, hominem in
miles idololatriæ, quod illi hominum condituram
insignem infra ligna & lapides abjiciant, isti
pulverem & cinerem, quin potius lutum sanie
elevarint. Ita e dissimili genere fatuitatis an
providentiæ nexibus emancipata in throno con-
fideat absoluta dominationis. Deus autem hu-
maxima caret parte regni illius quod scriptura
teram cladem intulerunt Divinæ gratiæ in Chri-
sto, quum Christum nihil nobis acquisivisse
sed hoc Deo ipsi acquisivisse docent, quod fœ-dum

page.notes: The word after "sed hoc" is printed as "'Deo", with a stray mark before the D; read as "Deo". The first letter of "Immanem" is a large decorative initial I, joined to the word. The line "Ita e dissimili genere fatuitatis" has a doubtful "fatuitatis" and a doubtful "dissimili" [?] in the scan, both read as shown. The ornamental band at the top is not transcribed.
